On the back, in his mother’s handwriting, were the words, “I’ll come home when the coast is safe.” At dawn, a ship appeared on the horizon, carrying her name.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还沉在薄薄的夜色里。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有几盏灯静静亮起，像远处未熄的星。清洁车沿着空旷的街道缓缓驶过，水光映出路灯淡黄的影子。早餐店刚掀开卷帘门，热气和面香悄悄漫到路边。偶尔有出租车驶过，车轮声很快消失在巷口。公园里，晨练的人还没到，树叶间先响起清脆的鸟鸣。城市仿佛暂时放慢了脚步，卸下白日的喧闹，在黎明来临前安静地呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version.\n- It needs a stopping rule, like reaching the bottom step, so it doesn’t keep going forever.\n- For example, to count a stack of blocks, count one block and then use the same idea for the smaller stack."}
